title: Baseline walkthrough: create, check, new finding, stale entries, prune, ignore
description: The walkthrough of BEP 1498 on a small package with 3 issues (1 HIGH ballerina:13, 2 LOW ballerina:1). Day 1 adopts the baseline, day 2 adds lines above, day 3 adds a hardcoded password, day 4 fixes old findings and prunes, then --ignore-baseline, --platform-triggered and accepting a finding with --create-baseline. The summary line, the baseline file and baselineState in the reports change step by step; the Baseline & fingerprints panel shows the entries added and removed. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: Configured baseline does not exist yet
steps.note: Exit 1: baseline scan-baseline.json set in Scan.toml does not exist; run 'bal scan --create-baseline' to create it. A typo in the path must not turn the baseline off. Nothing is scanned.

steps.name: Day 1: --create-baseline with a gate
steps.note: Exit 0: creating never trips the gate. "0 new issue(s), 3 in baseline" and "Saved 3 entries to the baseline at:". Nothing is printed on stdout ([]); scan_results.json holds all 3 as unchanged.

steps.name: --create-baseline again
steps.note: "The baseline already holds these 3 entries:" and the file is not rewritten (no file change, balScanVersion untouched).

steps.name: Day 3: a pull request adds a password
Day 3: scan with a gate
steps.note: Exit 1: 1 issue at or above HIGH. Only the new finding is printed (with baselineState new); 1 new issue(s), 3 in baseline.

steps.name: Day 3: SARIF
steps.note: baselineState is on every result (SARIF 3.27.24: all or none): 1 new, 3 unchanged.

steps.name: Day 4: two old findings fixed, the new one reverted
Day 4: scan
steps.note: Exit 0: 0 new issue(s), 1 in baseline, and the warning "2 entries of the baseline scan-baseline.json match no issue; run 'bal scan --prune-baseline' to remove them". A warning never changes the exit code.

steps.name: Day 4: --prune-baseline
steps.note: "Removed 2 stale entries from the baseline at:"; the file now has 1 entry. No warning.

steps.name: --prune-baseline again
steps.note: "The baseline has no entries to remove:"; file unchanged.

steps.name: --ignore-baseline
steps.note: The file is not read: every issue is printed, the summary is "4 issue(s)" with no "in baseline", no result carries baselineState, and the gate counts all of them (exit 1).

steps.name: --platform-triggered
steps.note: A platform tracks new code itself, so the baseline is ignored without a warning.

steps.name: Accept the new findings with --create-baseline
steps.note: Exit 0. The entries replaced: the 2 fixed ones are back plus backupPassword, so accepting shows up as a diff of the committed file.
